title: Shell words fail in a hosted session when ENGRAM_ACTOR_ID or ENGRAM_SESSION_ID is absent
outcome: On a local host the words never refuse for missing attribution: ENGRAM_ACTOR_ID defaults to the OS user and ENGRAM_SESSION_ID to a stable per-process id, both marked as defaulted in the audit; a host that injects the real values gets exact attribution
acceptance: a hosted session whose shell carries the injected values records them verbatim; parity covers CLI and MCP
engram work show and next succeed from a shell with only ENGRAM_HOME set and record the defaulted actor and session

completion.summary: Implemented default shell attribution for Engram work words: missing actor resolves from the OS-user environment with a distinct synthetic fallback, missing session resolves to a stable process-local identifier, both origins are audited, injected values remain verbatim, and the CLI advertises a reusable session id. Added CLI/MCP parity and provenance tests, updated shell-facing contracts, passed every required gate, and completed one Codex plus one Claude frozen review with no Critical/High/Medium findings.
